title: Annotatio VI §.I Prior Class: Genuine Luther disciples admitting Melanchthon’s varied Augsburg Confession (Art. X)
pass_a_gloss: The Prior Class, according to our Author, has as Disputators the genuine disciples of Luther — those who admit and approve (if not a priori, yet a posteriori) the Augsburg Confession as varied, that is declared and explained, by his milder, most faithful and dearest fellow-minister Philip Melanchthon, even as to the Tenth Article on the Sacred Supper — see Annot. I. §.6.
pass_b_english: The prior class, on his account, has as disputants Luther’s genuine disciples.
They admit Melanchthon’s milder, declared and explained Augsburg Confession — even Article X on the Sacred Supper — if not from the start, then afterward (see Annot. I. §.6).
source_text: Prior Classis juxta Autorem nostrum, Disputatores habet genuinos Lutheri, (puta placidioris, fidissimi charissimique Symmystae sui Philippi Melanchtonis variatam i. e. declaratam explicatamque August. Confessionem, etiam quod ad Xmum Articul. de Coena Sacra attinet,) si non à priori, à posteriori tamen, admittentis & approbantis, discipulos, vid. Annot. I. §.6.
notes: Prior Class; Melanchthon Variata; Art. X Coena; Annot. I §.6.
